title: Greenfield Python temperature-converter library
description: Build a simple Python library from scratch that converts between Celsius, Fahrenheit, and Kelvin.

task_spec.prompt:
Create a temperature converter library in src/temp_converter.py.

Implement:
  def celsius_to_fahrenheit(c: float) -> float  — formula: (c * 9/5) + 32
  def fahrenheit_to_celsius(f: float) -> float  — formula: (f - 32) * 5/9
  def celsius_to_kelvin(c: float) -> float      — formula: c + 273.15
  def kelvin_to_celsius(k: float) -> float      — formula: k - 273.15

Create a tests/test_temp.py with 5+ tests:
  test_boiling_point — celsius_to_fahrenheit(100) == 212.0
  test_freezing_point — celsius_to_fahrenheit(0) == 32.0
  test_body_temp — fahrenheit_to_celsius(98.6) is close to 37.0 (within 0.01)
  test_absolute_zero — celsius_to_kelvin(-273.15) == 0.0
  test_roundtrip — fahrenheit_to_celsius(celsius_to_fahrenheit(25)) is close to 25.0 (within 1e-9)

Run uv run pytest tests/ -q to confirm. Run uv run ruff check src/ to confirm.
required_artifacts: uv run ruff check src/ passes
followup_prompts: Run `uv run pytest tests/ -q` and show me which tests are passing and which are still failing. Fix any failures — pay attention to edge cases like empty input, boundary values, and error conditions.
Final check: run `uv run pytest tests/ -q` one more time. All tests must be green. If anything is still failing, trace through the failing assertion and fix it now.
